definition: A graph database represents and queries data as entities and relationships, typically expressed as nodes and edges.
entry_text: A graph database represents and queries data as entities and relationships, typically expressed as nodes and edges.
example: A travel app finds transfers by following connections among station nodes.
label: Graph databases

sources.note: The implementer describes property-graph entities and relationships as nodes and edges and explains traversal queries. ISO/IEC 39075:2024 independently confirms property-graph data structures and query operations: https://www.iso.org/standard/76120.html.
